items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire; moving and firing simultaneously works. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse) that damages self; warping does not outrun the fuse. Q/Space appear to do nothing. Empty heart outlines plus a blood-splatter visual = death.

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS (re-confirmed many times): warping needs near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1-0.2 units from the frame. Standing ON the frame blocks the warp; back off ~0.15, re-center, hold ~1.0-1.2s; multiple attempts are normal. A diagonal walk into the frame from the top row also triggered warps. Rocks can sit directly below a hatch and block vertical approach; route along the top row and walk sideways into the frame. Doorways may similarly need y-alignment: the start room's right-wall doorway was entered by diagonal up-right movement to align, then a straight right push; earlier a diagonal s+d push also entered. Whether diagonal input is strictly required or only y-alignment is unresolved (guess: y-alignment is what matters).

TECH X: earlier CONFIRMED that entering the two-poop room auto-grants Tech X ('Laser ring Tears'); re-obtainable there. But another run had no pedestal and plain tears, so verify on entry. In the later dark-chest-room run, firing left produced no visible laser ring, so Tech X status that run is uncertain (not proof it was absent).

LASERS (Tech X): firing creates a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15-0.2 units) along the firing row/column; rocks block it; rocks are NOT destroyed by lasers. The red squiggly ring is my own laser, not a lock marker/telegraph (uncertain). In the rock field an upward laser column hit and killed a white-faced chaser (blood visible), but I still lost half a heart to it first; chasers close fast, so fight only at range with correct row/column aim.

ROUTE/MAP (transitions observed unless noted):
- Start/mural room (floor start, instruction murals): top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> rock field; bottom hatch x~0.50 <-> torch room; right-side dark doorway (y~0.40-0.55, x~0.78-0.82) <-> dark chest room.
- Rock field (above start room): bottom hatch ~x0.50 <-> start room; top hatch x~0.50 <-> TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19-0.20, y~0.44-0.48. Hazards: fast-pursuing white-faced chasers clustering near hatches, green glowing blobs that expand into large damaging bursts, small spiky pellets (guess: turret), spiked wheels, blue-tear shooters, a spiked-ring enemy, and a spiked black rock ring with a gray enemy at room center. Severe heart drainer; do not loiter.
- Torch room (below start room): top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> start room; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50 <-> two-poop room (approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above). Center column is rock-choked; safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height and right lane x~0.63 traversable. Center gray chest is sealed by indestructible rocks—ABANDON. Corner torches damage on touch. Small dark specks near left wall (~0.30,0.43) treated as minor hazards.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown/gold hatch x~0.50, y~0.09-0.17 (approach from ~0.1 below; standing on frame blocks). Tech X auto-grants on entry. Poop piles are harmless and regenerate. Center rock vanished on a later visit (cause unknown; NOT attributable to lasers).
- TNT room: TNT barrels line the left wall and mid-room, block movement, are inert (don't shoot point-blank); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall (guess: key-locked); top dark hatch x~0.50 <-> pink-enemy room; bottom hatch <-> rock field. A bomb-holding walking enemy mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction; unclear if armored or offset hitbox—treat as dangerous.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies left-center; rock wall ring on right with three dark teardrop objects and a small blue creature (uncertain).

DARK CHEST ROOM: entered from the start room's right doorway. Layout: two red-lidded unspiked chests top (~0.33,0.32) and (~0.67,0.32); central spiked chest untouchable and emitting spike projectiles; small black cat-like chasers roaming (~0.33 and ~0.67 at y~0.50); yellow-green blob hazard at left (~0.26,0.48); blue/white pellets appeared near bottom during the fight (source uncertain). Pressing into a red-lidded chest did NOT clearly open it or yield an item; a chest later rendered with a gray/plain lid just before death (cause uncertain). DEATH LESSON: died here again starting from full 3 hearts—chasers plus blob/spike contact drained hearts fast. Treat this room as a high-damage death trap; avoid it, or only enter with a clear retreat and fight from range.

KEY: a key counter has read 01 in runs. KEYHOLE DOOR TESTED AND FAILED: with key 01, adjacent to the rock-field left-wall keyhole, pressing into it, aligning vertically, and firing left did NOT open it and did NOT consume the key. Meeting condition UNRESOLVED.

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact. Left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decor. Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact for a coin.

BOMBS: bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing—rocks judged indestructible. Never bomb at low health or adjacent to self.

HAZARDS/HEARTS: green glowing blobs damage on contact, transform (winged/spread/large fast forms), and can burst over large areas. Damage lands faster than warps can be set up. A mid-fight heart refill was seen once; mechanism uncertain (possibly a dropped pickup). At 1 or half a heart any contact ends the run—flee through a hatch/exit rather than fight.

UNRESOLVED: keyhole door opening condition; red-lidded chests/barrels and whether contact can ever open them; bomb-walker armor/hitbox; heart-refill mechanism; meaning of the red laser ring (uncertain); two-poop center-rock disappearance cause; whether the start-room right doorway strictly needs diagonal entry or only exact y-alignment; Tech X presence in later runs.
